spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Desciende, amonesta en el pueblo, no sea que rompan a Jehová a ver, y caiga de nosotros mucho.
grammarChanges: Replaced «irrumpan» (burst in) with «rompan» so the verb stays within Qal H2040's tear-down/break-down/destroy sense instead of narrowing to a sudden entrance.
Corrected the suffix on «de él» (3rd masculine singular) to «de nosotros», matching מִמֶּנּוּ (1st common plural, "from us").
readerNote: Chose «rompan» (break/break down) for Qal H2040 in place of the narrower «irrumpan» (burst in); both read, with «a Jehová», as the people breaking through toward the LORD, not acting on Him.
